# Dr. Darshana Reddy — drdarshanareddy.com
> Senior Consultant, Internal Medicine & Metabolic Diseases, Bangalore.
> MBBS, MD, DNB (Internal Medicine), FID, DAA, FICP, Cert. Obesity Specialist (Harvard).
> This site provides general health information. It does not provide medical advice.

## Site overview
Official website of Dr. Darshana Reddy, a physician in Bangalore (HBR Layout)
practising at Even Hospital since 2010. Focus areas: internal medicine,
diabetes & metabolic diseases, obesity care, allergy & asthma, respiratory
care, and preventive medicine.

The site includes an AI chat widget that answers general health questions and
